checkpoint_finding.interpretation: Conditionally eligible for a best openly licensed model claim. The exact held-back effects were not used, but the reference loci and an independent eQTL classification task were exposed during pretraining and downstream demonstration, respectively.

known_incidents_and_biases: Raw RCPS channels are equivariant, not directly invariant; incorrect channel splitting or flipping silently breaks strand symmetry.
The official VEP representation concatenates REF and ALT pooled embeddings and fits an SVM; this does not predict signed cell-type effects.
The environment file has internally inconsistent CUDA declarations and a duplicated torchaudio entry.
Mamba and causal-conv1d compiled kernels require device-specific numerical and determinism checks.
The model has seen hg38 reference sequence and must not be described as locus-clean.
